content.title: Sprite Zone Editor – Bézier & Polygon Toolkit
about: A Unity EditorWindow (UI Toolkit) to create and manage sprite-based zones using polygons or Bézier paths.
Includes optional runtime support to bake paths to polygons and visualize zones for debugging.
features: Pen/Move/Add/Remove tools for drawing and editing zones
Generators: Hexagon, Circle, AutoBody Pen, Full Body generation
AutoBody: generate zones from Sprite Physics Shape
Bézier path flattening with tolerance control
Runtime baking to polygons + optional debug viewer
Clipper2Lib integration for polygon boolean operations
learnings: Building production editor tooling with UI Toolkit (UXML/USS)
Robust geometry workflows: Bézier flattening, polygon ops, and tolerance handling
Clean Runtime/Editor boundaries via assembly definitions
